title: DO. NOT. BUY.
text: DO. NOT. BUY.. I think in all my years with Amazon I've never given 1 star on anything, until now. This product is terrible and does NOT match the product description. I reread the description after it arrived to see if I made assumptions, but it clearly attempts to indicate the entire screen is touch screen and you can control all the features. There are 3 controls. On/off. Speed. Timer. That's it. And there is NO way it would clean the air in a bedroom. At most this thing would clean the air that is directly around it. So maybe would be ok if it was at a desk and sitting right by your side, but there is no way it would clean your entire office or even cubicle. Even if you get it for your desk tho, you'll likely need an extension cord of some kind, as the cord is very short. Just do yourself a favor and invest a little more money in something higher quality.
